exposure: Nulliparous pregnant people undergoing induction of labor
gestational weight gain above the Institute of Medicine recommendation
Pre-pregnancy body mass index (normal weight vs. obesity)
cohort: 557 nulliparous pregnant people with normal weight or obesity who underwent induction of labor between 37 and 41 weeks gestation
finding: Pre-pregnancy obesity was associated with higher cesarean delivery rates in nulliparous pregnant people undergoing induction of labor compared to normal pre-pregnancy body mass index.
mod_finding: This study focused on the impact of pre-pregnancy obesity on cesarean delivery rates and did not compare outcomes between other modes of delivery.
